subject: microbiology
title: CAMP Test, Pneumococcus Identification and Optochin Sensitivity

steps.tx: The **CAMP test** streaks the candidate perpendicular to a Staphylococcus aureus beta lysin producer on sheep blood agar: group B streptococcus CAMP factor synergises with staphylococcal sphingomyelinase to arrowhead haemolysis at the junction, identifying S agalactiae presumptively (reverse CAMP names Clostridium perfringens in the anaerobe lessons).
steps.say: Arrowhead at the cross means CAMP positive: group B's bench signature.

left.title: CAMP mechanics
points: S aureus beta toxin preps red cells
Arrowhead points toward the staph streak

right.title: CAMP cautions
points: Some group A and others weakly positive
Confirm by grouping latex or hippurate
Reverse CAMP: C perfringens inhibits (anaerobe module)
Chromogenic and molecular screening sideline it

steps.tx: **Streptococcus pneumoniae** (pneumococcus) is a lancet shaped gram positive diplococcus, alpha haemolytic, optochin susceptible, bile soluble, capsulated (Quellung), autolytic (draughtsman colonies), causing pneumonia, meningitis, otitis and sepsis especially at age extremes and after splenectomy. It is streptococcus only by ancestry (own identification liturgy).
steps.say: Lancet diplococci, alpha zone, optochin killed, bile dissolved: pneumococcus in four tests.

vis.alt: Pneumococcal disease pathology and manifestations diagram
vis.caption: Pneumococcal disease across lung, meninges and blood, optochin susceptible alpha haemolytic diplococcus.

steps.tx: The **optochin test** (ethylhydrocupreine disc, Taxo P) inhibits pneumococcus (zone 14 mm and above susceptible) while viridans streptococci resist, remembering optochin's discarded career as pneumococcal drug halted by optic toxicity like the other retired disc drugs. Bile solubility arbitrates ambiguous zones.
steps.say: Optochin zones sort pneumococcus from viridans; bile settles disputed zones.

left.title: Optochin bench
points: 5 ug disc on blood agar in CO2

right.title: Optochin history
points: Optic nerve toxicity ended systemic use

steps.tx: **Capsule and serotypes** govern pneumococcal disease and vaccines: over ninety polysaccharide serotypes (Quellung typed), conjugate vaccines marrying dominant childhood types to protein, polysaccharide PPSV23 broader and T independent, serotype replacement after conjugate programmes (19A story) tracked by surveillance, invasive potential varying by serotype.
steps.say: Ninety coats, vaccine chooses the childhood worst; replacement keeps surveillance employed.

steps.tx: **Pneumococcal disease burden** concentrates where defence is thin: extremes of age, asplenia, HIV, chronic lung and heart disease, diabetes, alcohol, CSF leaks for meningitis recurrence, preceding influenza for pneumonia. Vaccination and prompt antibiotics divide its mortality, blood cultures before antibiotics its diagnosis.
steps.say: No spleen, no capsule defence: pneumococcus audits immune gaps lethally.

right.title: Defence gaps
points: Antibody deficiency and complement early defects

steps.tx: **Pneumococcal susceptibility** evolved by transformation (mosaic PBPs from viridans DNA) into penicillin and multidrug resistance, breakpoints split by meningitis (strict) versus pneumonia (generous), ceftriaxone and vancomycin guarding meningitis until MICs return, macrolide and fluoroquinolone patterns regional. Site writes interpretation, from the susceptibility module.
steps.say: Same MIC, two verdicts: meningitis strict, pneumonia lenient, breakpoints know the address.

right.title: Empirical logic
points: Meningitis: ceftriaxone plus vancomycin until MIC
Pneumonia: beta lactam backbone, macrolide by guideline
De escalate on MIC and syndrome day two

steps.tx: **Urinary antigen and molecular tests** assist pneumococcal pneumonia (urine antigen persists, childhood carriage false positives), CSF antigen and multiplex PCR in meningitis after antibiotics, while culture and susceptibility still arbitrate therapy. Autolysis (bile, optochin plates left too long) explains vanishing colonies and draughtsman centres.
steps.say: Antigen tests remember pneumococcus after antibiotics erase culture; colonies autolyse if you wait.

left.title: Non culture tools
points: CSF latex and PCR post antibiotics
Blood PCR panels after culture flag

right.title: Autolysis phenomena
points: Old cultures Gram variable and lysed

steps.tx: **Non encapsulated pneumococci** and colonisation close: carriage in children's nasopharynx (transmission reservoir, antibiotic pressure cooker), non typeable strains causing conjunctivitis and otitis locally, and colonisation preceding disease by serotype specific risk. Carriage studies are vaccine trials' surrogate engine. Invasive potential also guides empiric therapy intensity, because high risk serotypes are covered aggressively even before full susceptibility patterns are documented.
steps.say: Children carry, serotypes compete, disease samples the carriage pool.

right.title: From carriage to disease
points: Invasive potential varies by serotype (1, 7F high)
